formats.key: vaultBundlesV1Deposit(address vault, uint256 assets, uint256 maxSharePriceE27, (uint8 kind, bytes data) assetPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
effects: The contract takes `assets` of the vault's underlying token from the signer. It uses transferFrom, an ERC-2612 permit or a Permit2 signature for exactly `assets`, with the bundler as spender.
When the signer sends native value, msg.value must equal `assets`. The contract wraps it into the wrapped-native token and does not pull any tokens.
The contract sends `assets * referralFeePct / 1e18` of the underlying token to `referralFeeRecipient`.
The contract deposits `assets - fee` into `vault`, and the vault mints the shares to the signer.
The deposit reverts when the share price is above `maxSharePriceE27`. This sets the minimum number of shares the signer receives.
The bundler approves the vault for the maximum amount of its own balance. This is not the signer's allowance.
formats.shown: The screen shows "Deposit to vault with X% referral fee", the vault address, a raw base-unit amount with no token, the native value when it is not zero, the fee %, the fee recipient when it is not zero, and the deadline. It shows no shares received and no bound on them.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Deposit hides maxSharePriceE27, the only bound on how few vault shares the signer receives.
findings.evidence: VaultBundlesV1.vaultBundlesV1Deposit: `uint256 shares = IERC4626(vault).deposit(toDeposit, msg.sender); require(toDeposit.mulDivUp(1e27, shares) <= maxSharePriceE27, SlippageExceeded());`. Descriptor: `{"label": "Max share price", "path": "#.maxSharePriceE27", "visible": "never"}`. Cases 0, 1, 3 and 4: the signer receives 1917.03 gtusdcp, 9592.8 steakUSDC, 0.001625 mwETH and 0.04919 CSRETH. No field states the shares or a minimum.
findings.fix: Make `#.maxSharePriceE27` visible. Use the label "Max share price (assets per share, 1e27 scale)" and the format `raw`, or a `unit` format if one fits. Leave it out of `interpolatedIntent`.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Deposit shows the amount raw with the label "Base units, with fee", which a signer misreads.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `{"label": "Base units, with fee", "format": "raw", "path": "#.assets"}`. Code: `toDeposit = assets - referralFeeAssets`. Case 0 shows "2000000000" for 2000 USDC. The blind reader did not know the token or the size.
findings.fix: Change the label to "Amount incl. referral fee (vault asset base units)".

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Deposit interpolatedIntent does not name the vault that receives the deposit.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"interpolatedIntent": "Deposit to vault with {#.referralFeePct} referral fee"`. The `#.vault` field is always visible and is an address.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Deposit hides the fee recipient when it is the zero address, even when the fee is above zero.
findings.evidence: Code: `if (referralFeeAssets > 0) SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer(asset, referralFeeRecipient, referralFeeAssets);`. Descriptor: Fee recipient `"visible": {"ifNotIn": ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"]}`. With a fee above zero and a zero recipient, the fee can go to address(0) and no recipient is shown.
findings.fix: Make the field `"visible": "always"`, or show the zero address with a message such as "Burn (no recipient)".

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Deposit cannot name the underlying token, because it comes from vault.asset() and not from calldata.
findings.evidence: Code: `address asset = IERC4626(vault).asset(); TokenLib.pullOrWrapNative(asset, msg.sender, assets, assetPermit);`. Cases 0, 1 and 3 send USDC and WETH. The screen shows only the base units.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Deposit hides the asset permit. It grants the bundler exactly `assets`, and the bundler spends it in the same call.
findings.evidence: TokenLib.pullToken: `IERC20Permit(token).permit(from, address(this), amount, deadline, v, r, s)` followed by `safeTransferFrom(token, from, address(this), amount)`. Descriptor: `#.assetPermit` is `visible: never`. Case 0 has a grant of 2000 USDC to the bundler, and the same transaction spends it.

cases.notes: The screen shows the 2000 USDC out only as the raw number 2000000000 with no token. It does not show the permit grant to the bundler or the 1917.03 gtusdcp shares in.
The screen shows the 10000 USDC out raw with no token. It does not show the 9592.8 steakUSDC shares in.
The screen shows the WETH out raw with no token. It does not show the 0.001625 mwETH shares in.
The screen shows the 0.0501 ETH out correctly. It does not show the 0.04919 CSRETH shares in.

formats.key: vaultBundlesV1Withdraw(address vault, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, (uint256 value, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) sharesPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
effects: When the shares permit is not empty, the contract submits it. The signer approves the bundler for `sharesPermit.value` vault shares.
The contract burns the signer's vault shares. In shares mode it burns exactly `shares`. In assets mode it burns as many as the vault needs for `assets`, with no maximum.
The contract sends `withdrawn * referralFeePct / 1e18` of the underlying token to `referralFeeRecipient`.
The signer receives `withdrawn - fee` of the underlying token. In shares mode there is no minimum.
formats.shown: The screen shows "Withdraw from vault", the vault address, either a raw base-unit asset amount or a share amount with its token, the fee and the fee recipient when they are not zero, and the deadline.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Withdraw shows the asset amount as raw base units with no token, so the signer cannot read the size.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `{"label": "Withdraw before fee (base units)", "format": "raw", "path": "#.assets"}`. Case 6 shows "2147969" for 2.147969 USDC. The blind reader did not know the token or its decimals.
findings.fix: Change the label to "Assets out before fee (vault asset base units)". No format can resolve vault.asset().

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Withdraw hides the fee recipient when it is the zero address, while a non-zero fee is shown.
findings.evidence: Code: `if (referralFeeAssets > 0) SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer(asset, referralFeeRecipient, referralFeeAssets);`. Descriptor: Fee recipient `ifNotIn` the zero address.
findings.fix: Show the recipient whenever `referralFeePct` is not zero, or show the zero address with a message.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Withdraw has no test with a non-zero referral fee, so the conditional fee fields are never rendered.
findings.evidence: Cases 5 and 6 both have `referralFeePct` 0. The Referral fee and Fee recipient fields are `ifNotIn` 0 and the zero address.
findings.fix: Add a test case with a non-zero referral fee and a recipient.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Withdraw has no bound in calldata for the assets received or the shares burned.
findings.evidence: Code: `else assets = IERC4626(vault).redeem(shares, address(this), msg.sender);` with no minimum. The NatSpec says "The vault share price is not checked". Case 5: the signer receives 498.889229 USDC and the screen does not show it. Case 6: the signer burns 2.0589 gtusdcp and the screen does not show it.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Withdraw cannot name the underlying token received, because it comes from vault.asset().
findings.evidence: Code: `address asset = IERC4626(vault).asset(); ... safeTransfer(asset, msg.sender, assets - referralFeeAssets);`. Cases 5 and 6 send USDC to the signer, and the screen does not name it.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Withdraw hides the shares permit. It approves the bundler for share value that the bundler can only redeem for the signer.
findings.evidence: TokenLib.submitPermit: `IERC20Permit(token).permit(msg.sender, address(this), permit.value, ...)`. The withdraw uses `owner = msg.sender`. Descriptor: `#.sharesPermit` is `visible: never`. Case 5 has a grant of 498.087 NOONECOUSDC to the bundler, and the same transaction spends it.

cases.notes: The screen shows the 498.087 NOONECOUSDC shares out correctly. It does not show the permit grant or the 498.889 USDC in.
The screen does not show the 2.0589 gtusdcp shares burned. It shows the 2.147969 USDC in only as the raw number 2147969 with no token.

formats.key: vaultBundlesV1Migrate(address sourceVault, address destVault, uint256 assetsWithdrawn, uint256 sharesRedeemed, uint256 destMaxSharePriceE27, (uint256 value, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) sharesPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
effects: When the shares permit is not empty, the contract submits it. The signer approves the bundler for `sharesPermit.value` source vault shares.
The contract burns the signer's source vault shares, by `sharesRedeemed` or by `assetsWithdrawn`.
The contract sends `withdrawn * referralFeePct / 1e18` of the underlying token to `referralFeeRecipient`.
The contract deposits `withdrawn - fee` into `destVault`, and the destination vault mints the shares to the signer.
The move reverts when the destination share price is above `destMaxSharePriceE27`. This is the minimum number of destination shares.
formats.shown: The screen shows "Move to another vault with X% referral fee", the source and destination vaults, the shares to move or a raw asset amount, the fee %, the fee recipient when it is not zero, and the deadline. It shows no destination shares and no bound on them.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Migrate hides destMaxSharePriceE27, the only bound on how few destination shares the signer receives.
findings.evidence: VaultBundlesV1.vaultBundlesV1Migrate: `uint256 sharesMinted = IERC4626(destVault).deposit(toDeposit, msg.sender); require(toDeposit.mulDivUp(1e27, sharesMinted) <= destMaxSharePriceE27, SlippageExceeded());`. Descriptor: `#.destMaxSharePriceE27` is `visible: never`. Case 7: the signer receives 0.041833 gtwethb, and no field states it or a minimum.
findings.fix: Make `#.destMaxSharePriceE27` visible with the label "Max share price at destination (1e27 scale)" and the format `raw`. Leave it out of `interpolatedIntent`.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Migrate labels the raw withdrawn amount "Base units, with fee" and does not name a token.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `{"label": "Base units, with fee", "format": "raw", "path": "#.assetsWithdrawn"}`. Code: `toDeposit = assetsWithdrawn - referralFeeAssets`.
findings.fix: Change the label to "Assets withdrawn incl. fee (base units)".

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Migrate interpolatedIntent names neither the source vault nor the destination vault.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"interpolatedIntent": "Move to another vault with {#.referralFeePct} referral fee"`. `#.sourceVault` and `#.destVault` are always visible.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Migrate hides the fee recipient when it is the zero address, while the fee is above zero.
findings.evidence: Code: `if (referralFeeAssets > 0) SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer(asset, referralFeeRecipient, referralFeeAssets);`. Descriptor: Fee recipient `ifNotIn` the zero address.
findings.fix: Show the recipient whenever the fee is not zero, or add a message for the zero address.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Migrate has no test with a non-zero fee and no test that withdraws by assets.
findings.evidence: Case 7 is the only case. It has `referralFeePct` 0 and `assetsWithdrawn` 0, so the Fee recipient and "Base units, with fee" fields are never rendered.
findings.fix: Add test cases with a non-zero referral fee and with `assetsWithdrawn` set.

findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Migrate hides the shares permit, which grants the bundler source shares that it spends at once.
findings.evidence: TokenLib.submitPermit: `permit(msg.sender, address(this), permit.value, ...)`. Case 7 has a grant of 0.04033 gtWETHc to the bundler, and the same transaction spends it.

cases.notes: The screen shows the 0.04033 gtWETHc shares out correctly. It does not show the permit grant or the 0.041833 gtwethb in.

findings.format: vaultBundlesV1Deposit(address vault, uint256 assets, uint256 maxSharePriceE27, (uint8 kind, bytes data) assetPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Deposit hides maxSharePriceE27, the only bound on how few vault shares the signer receives.
findings.reason: The signer chooses maxSharePriceE27 in calldata, and it is the only check on how few shares the vault mints to them. The descriptor hides it with `visible: never`, and no field shows the shares or a minimum. This matches the guide's critical example "how little may come back, is not shown". It is not covered by not-critical #6 (that case is `visible: optional`) or #3 (this is a calldata bound, not a value read from storage).
findings.quote: VaultBundlesV1.sol, vaultBundlesV1Deposit: `uint256 shares = IERC4626(vault).deposit(toDeposit, msg.sender); require(toDeposit.mulDivUp(1e27, shares) <= maxSharePriceE27, SlippageExceeded());`. Descriptor: `{"label": "Max share price", "path": "#.maxSharePriceE27", "visible": "never"}`. Case 0 screen shows only Vault, "Base units, with fee" 2000000000, Referral fee 0% and Deadline, while the signer receives 1917030928050759063648 gtusdcp.

findings.format: vaultBundlesV1Migrate(address sourceVault, address destVault, uint256 assetsWithdrawn, uint256 sharesRedeemed, uint256 destMaxSharePriceE27, (uint256 value, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) sharesPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Migrate hides destMaxSharePriceE27, the only bound on how few destination shares the signer receives.
findings.reason: destMaxSharePriceE27 is the only calldata bound on how many destination-vault shares the signer receives, and the descriptor hides it with `visible: never`. No field shows the shares received or a minimum, so the screen does not state how little may come back. This is critical under the severity guide, and no not-critical case applies.
findings.quote: VaultBundlesV1.sol, vaultBundlesV1Migrate: `uint256 sharesMinted = IERC4626(destVault).deposit(toDeposit, msg.sender); require(toDeposit.mulDivUp(1e27, sharesMinted) <= destMaxSharePriceE27, SlippageExceeded());`. Descriptor: `{"label": "Max share price", "path": "#.destMaxSharePriceE27", "visible": "never"}`. Case 7 screen shows From vault, To vault, "Shares to move" 0.04033210861146132 gtWETHc, Referral fee and Deadline, while the signer receives 41832542822934993 gtwethb.

findings.format: vaultBundlesV1Deposit(address vault, uint256 assets, uint256 maxSharePriceE27, (uint8 kind, bytes data) assetPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Deposit hides maxSharePriceE27, the only bound on how few vault shares the signer receives.
findings.reason: The hidden calldata parameter sets the minimum acceptable shares for the deposited assets. No other displayed field states that bound; the exception for outputs derived by the vault does not cover this explicit input limit.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x02912516d49de997db75b9d7858faae59209650b/src/lib/bundles/src/vault/VaultBundlesV1.sol, vaultBundlesV1Deposit: `uint256 shares = IERC4626(vault).deposit(toDeposit, msg.sender); require(toDeposit.mulDivUp(1e27, shares) <= maxSharePriceE27, SlippageExceeded());`. descriptor.json, vaultBundlesV1Deposit: `{"label":"Max share price","path":"#.maxSharePriceE27","visible":"never"}`. cases/0.json, screen: `"intent":"Deposit to vault"`; fields show only Vault, Base units with fee, Referral fee, and Deadline.

findings.format: vaultBundlesV1Migrate(address sourceVault, address destVault, uint256 assetsWithdrawn, uint256 sharesRedeemed, uint256 destMaxSharePriceE27, (uint256 value, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) sharesPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
findings.title: vaultBundlesV1Migrate hides destMaxSharePriceE27, the only bound on how few destination shares the signer receives.
